profile_text.body:
Coursera is a for-profit public company founded in 2012 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, trading under the ticker COUR. It describes itself as offering online courses, Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees from providers including Google, Meta, Anthropic, DeepLearning.AI, and Stanford. Its site presents these programs as a way to build job-ready skills and earn verifiable credentials, with learners commonly moving into roles in project management, UX design, and data science.

Its AI-related offerings include the AI Essentials Specialization, the AI Engineer Professional Certificate, the Machine Learning Specialization, and the Deep Learning Specialization, alongside beginner-friendly Python and generative AI courses. Coursera Plus is described as an annual subscription giving unlimited access to thousands of courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates, which the company positions for learners planning to complete multiple programs in a year. Other named programs include the Google Project Management, Google UX Design, Google Cybersecurity, IBM Data Science, and IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificates, the Data Analysis with Python Specialization, and the UI/UX Design Specialization.

Company records list no lawsuits and no MCP servers. Its recorded legal exposure is in California, with 264 cases.
